description: Everything about a veHYDX voting-escrow position on Base, read live: each NFT's current owner (resolved with ownerOf at call time, never assumed), its voting power, its locked HYDX, and whether it can ever be unlocked. Also reports oHYDX, the separate OPTION token, with its live exercise economics — oHYDX and veHYDX are different things and this tool keeps them apart on purpose. Works for any Hydrex holder: pass an address, or omit it to read the position this server operates. Free, keyless, read-only — it cannot sign or move anything.

address.description: Optional: a wallet to inspect. Omit to read our own position, whose owner is resolved live rather than hardcoded.

tokenIds.description: Optional: specific veHYDX token IDs. Omit to discover them, or to use our known IDs.

name: hydrex_position
title: A Hydrex veHYDX position: locks, voting power, and who owns it right now
